cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Challenge the captain's queue-jumping rule tonight. I taught you to build an argument; this is a chance to show it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He cancelled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask for that back too. You're finally gathering evidence. I'll help you write the speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign it, then. I want him to know it's both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still want your teacher to do the frightening part. Leave a space for my name. Once he agrees with you, call me up and I'll sign.
